constraints.definition: CHECK (((application_id IS NOT NULL) <> (payment_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: application_documents_application_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: application_documents_one_owner

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: application_education_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((completion_date IS NULL) OR (start_date IS NULL) OR (completion_date >= start_date)))

constraints.name: application_experience_application_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: application_experience_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((end_date IS NULL) OR (start_date IS NULL) OR (end_date >= start_date)))

constraints.name: history_one_actor
constraints.definition: CHECK (((actor_id IS NULL) OR (actor_applicant_id IS NULL)))

constraints.name: applications_one_owner
constraints.definition: CHECK (((user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (applicant_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: audit_one_actor
constraints.definition: CHECK (((actor_id IS NULL) OR (actor_applicant_id IS NULL)))

constraints.name: notifications_one_owner
constraints.definition: CHECK (((user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (applicant_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: payment_quotes_one_owner
constraints.definition: CHECK (((user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (applicant_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: principal_quote_checkout
constraints.definition: CHECK (((applicant_id IS NULL) OR (guest_checkout_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: quote_checkout_owner
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (guest_checkout_id, applicant_id) REFERENCES guest_checkouts(id, applicant_id)

constraints.name: quote_checkout_requires_principal
constraints.definition: CHECK (((guest_checkout_id IS NULL) OR (applicant_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: payment_checkout_owner
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (guest_checkout_id, applicant_id) REFERENCES guest_checkouts(id, applicant_id)

constraints.name: payment_checkout_requires_principal
constraints.definition: CHECK (((guest_checkout_id IS NULL) OR (applicant_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: payments_one_owner
constraints.definition: CHECK (((user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (applicant_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: principal_payment_checkout
constraints.definition: CHECK (((applicant_id IS NULL) OR (guest_checkout_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: quoted_payment_has_snapshot
constraints.definition: CHECK (((quote_id IS NULL) OR ((currency = 'GHS'::text) AND (product_name IS NOT NULL) AND (country_code IS NOT NULL) AND (price_source = ANY (ARRAY['base'::text, 'region'::text, 'country'::text])) AND (price_source IS NOT NULL) AND (display_amount IS NOT NULL) AND ((display_amount >= 1) AND (display_amount <= '9007199254740991'::bigint)) AND (display_currency IS NOT NULL) AND (display_currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text) AND (display_minor_units IS NOT NULL) AND ((display_minor_units >= 0) AND (display_minor_units <= 4)) AND ((display_currency = 'GHS'::text) OR ((exchange_rate IS NOT NULL) AND (exchange_rate > (0)::numeric) AND (exchange_rate_source IS NOT NULL) AND (exchange_rate_as_of IS NOT NULL))))))

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: voucher_access_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((credential_state = 'legacy'::text) AND (legacy_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (pin_hash IS NULL) AND (credential_version = 0) AND (credential_rotated_at IS NULL)) OR ((credential_state = 'pending_delivery'::text) AND (legacy_user_id IS NULL) AND (pin_hash IS NULL) AND (credential_version = 0) AND (credential_rotated_at IS NULL)) OR ((credential_state = 'current'::text) AND (pin_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (pin_hash ~ '^s[12]:[a-f0-9]{32}:[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text) AND (credential_version > 0) AND (credential_rotated_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: voucher_contact_challenges_contact_id_voucher_access_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (contact_id, voucher_access_id) REFERENCES voucher_contacts(id, voucher_access_id)

constraints.name: voucher_price_overrides_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((country_code IS NOT NULL))::integer + ((region_id IS NOT NULL))::integer) = 1))

constraints.name: active_voucher_requires_price
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT active) OR (amount IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: voucher_credential_owner
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (pin_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (pin_encrypted IS NOT NULL)) OR ((applicant_id IS NOT NULL) AND (pin_hash IS NULL) AND (pin_encrypted IS NULL))))

constraints.name: vouchers_one_owner
constraints.definition: CHECK (((user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (applicant_id IS NOT NULL)))
